description: This file defines the MassUpdate class used for performing mass updates on records in SuiteCRM, a fork of SugarCRM. It contains methods for generating mass update forms, handling form submissions, and adding various input fields such as text, date, select, and popup modules. The class facilitates UI generation and processing for batch record modifications in the CRM system.

classes.name: MassUpdate
classes.description: A class providing methods for generating and processing mass update forms in SuiteCRM, enabling batch record modifications including field updates, record deletion, and relationship management through various input widgets and popup modules.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Assigns the provided sugarbean reference to the class for further operations.

methods.name: getDisplayMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the mass update form UI.

methods.name: getMassUpdateFormHeader
methods.description: Creates the header section of the mass update form, including hidden fields and module-specific parameters.

methods.name: handleMassUpdate
methods.description: Processes the submitted mass update form, applying changes to selected records, including delete and sync operations.

methods.name: getMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Returns the complete HTML of the mass update form, including fields and buttons.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Builds the SQL WHERE clause based on search criteria for filtering records.

methods.name: date_to_dateTime
methods.description: Converts a date string into a datetime string, preserving the old time component.

methods.name: checkClearField
methods.description: Clears the associated field if the value indicates a clear operation.

methods.name: endMassUpdateForm
methods.description: Returns the closing tag for the mass update form.

methods.name: addParent
methods.description: Generates HTML for a parent record selection popup input.

methods.name: addInputType
methods.description: Creates an HTML text input widget for mass update.

methods.name: addUserName
methods.description: Creates a user lookup widget with popup for mass update.

methods.name: addGenericModuleID
methods.description: Creates a module lookup widget with popup for mass update.

methods.name: addAccountID
methods.description: Creates an account lookup widget with popup for mass update.

methods.name: addAssignedUserID
methods.description: Creates an assigned user lookup widget with popup for mass update.

methods.name: addStatus
methods.description: Generates a dropdown/select widget for status fields.

methods.name: addBool
methods.description: Creates a boolean (checkbox or dropdown) widget for mass update.

methods.name: addStatusMulti
methods.description: Creates a multi-select widget for status fields.

methods.name: addDate
methods.description: Creates a date picker widget for mass update.

methods.name: addRadioenumItem
methods.description: Generates a single radio button HTML for an enum value.

methods.name: addRadioenum
methods.description: Creates a set of radio buttons for enum options.

methods.name: addDatetime
methods.description: Creates a datetime picker widget for mass update.
